32-shape-morphing-gallery.visual_critic_note: Intentional Paul Tol palette and clean card grid show design awareness, but 5 of 9 cells are blank in the screenshot due to staggered setTimeout initialization — half the gallery never renders visibly at capture time.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.encoding_integrity_note: Morphing gallery with correct zero baselines for bars/areas and area-correct pack layout for circles, but hardcoded domains ([0,1], [0,1.2]) throughout and the grouped→stacked transition uses a fixed y-domain of 1.2 while stacked cumulative values from random data can reach ~1.5, risking silent bar overflow.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.stress_test_note: Fully automated animation with no user interaction handlers eliminates update-storm, feedback-loop, and touch-fight risks, but initStarCircle's tweenPts always interpolates from fixed starPts/circlePts endpoints rather than current DOM state (unlike the correct __arcParams pattern used in arcTween), creating a stale-closure snap if any transition were ever interrupted.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.cognitive_load_note: 9-cell gallery with bounded, self-contained animations reads as a clean demo grid — no cross-panel linking to track — but 9 simultaneous looping morphs at offset phases will compete for attention in motion; static screenshot can't assess whether the concurrent animation load feels chaotic or manageable.
